programs.title: Point Guard Game IQ — High School
programs.summary: 3 days a week, 15 minutes a day. Point Guard game iq + film program for high school players. Mix of foundation work and game-speed reps.

drills.name: Spacing audit
drills.description: Watch your team's clips. Pause randomly. Are all 5 players in the right spots? What's missing?

drills.name: Recognize defensive set
drills.description: Watch a half-court possession. Identify: man, 2-3 zone, 3-2 zone, switch, or junk. Bonus: what's the weak spot.

drills.name: Mental walkthrough of yesterday's shoot-around
drills.description: Sit somewhere quiet. Close your eyes. Walk through every shot you took yesterday. Where were you? How did it feel?

drills.name: Watch your role model
drills.description: Pick a player whose game you want to mirror. Watch 10 of their possessions. Take notes on their footwork and decision-making.

drills.name: Closeout recognition
drills.description: Find clips of contested 3s. Pause as the shooter catches. Predict: closeout type and best counter (shoot, rip, drive baseline).

drills.name: Free throw mental rep
drills.description: Sit. Visualize the routine: 3 dribbles, breath, eyes up, shoot. 10 reps. No ball needed.

programs.title: Point Guard Game IQ — High School

drills.name: Spacing audit

drills.name: Mental walkthrough of yesterday's shoot-around
drills.description: Sit somewhere quiet. Close your eyes. Walk through every shot you took yesterday. Where were you? How did it feel?

drills.name: Watch pre-game from a pro
drills.description: Watch a player's pre-game warmup on YouTube. Note the structure. Steal anything that fits your game.

drills.name: Late-clock decision drill
drills.description: Find clips with under :07 left on the shot clock. What do they go to? Note the patterns.

drills.name: Watch your role model
drills.description: Pick a player whose game you want to mirror. Watch 10 of their possessions. Take notes on their footwork and decision-making.

drills.name: Self-film review (any phone footage)

drills.name: 3-point catch-and-shoot from 5 spots
drills.description: Same 5 spots, behind the line. Spin pass, strong base, no fade.

drills.name: Rip-through to shot
drills.description: Catch above the break, rip through to the rim, gather, shoot in one motion.

drills.name: Game-speed shooting under closeout
drills.description: Closeout from a partner or chair. Read it — catch and shoot, or one-dribble pull. Game decision.

drills.name: Side-step 3
drills.description: From the wing, one side-step dribble, square, shoot. Both feet behind the line.

drills.name: Off-the-dribble 3 from the wing
drills.description: One side-step dribble before the pull. Stay behind the line. Rhythm matters.

drills.name: Catch-and-shoot from 5 spots
drills.description: Spin pass to yourself. Catch in shot pocket, square hips and shoulders, shoot in rhythm. Spots: left corner, left wing, top, right wing, right corner.

drills.name: ATO study
drills.description: After-timeout sets. Find 3 examples from a college game. Why does it work? Who's the second cutter?

drills.name: Late-clock decision drill
drills.description: Find clips with under :07 left on the shot clock. What do they go to? Note the patterns.

drills.name: Identify your tendency on film
drills.description: Watch 5 clips of your own play. What do you do too often? What do you avoid?

drills.name: Watch a possession and call it
drills.description: Watch one offensive possession from a recent NBA/college game. Pause before the play ends and call out what the offense is trying to do.

drills.name: Self-film review (any phone footage)
drills.description: Find one clip of yourself playing. Watch it 3 times. Different focus each watch: feet, hands, decision.

drills.name: Spacing audit
drills.description: Watch your team's clips. Pause randomly. Are all 5 players in the right spots? What's missing?

drills.name: Scout-yourself drill
drills.description: Write a one-paragraph scouting report on yourself. What would an opposing coach tell their team about you?

drills.name: Recognize defensive set
drills.description: Watch a half-court possession. Identify: man, 2-3 zone, 3-2 zone, switch, or junk. Bonus: what's the weak spot.

drills.name: Self-film review (any phone footage)
drills.description: Find one clip of yourself playing. Watch it 3 times. Different focus each watch: feet, hands, decision.

drills.name: Closeout recognition
drills.description: Find clips of contested 3s. Pause as the shooter catches. Predict: closeout type and best counter (shoot, rip, drive baseline).

drills.name: Free throw mental rep
drills.description: Sit. Visualize the routine: 3 dribbles, breath, eyes up, shoot. 10 reps. No ball needed.

drills.name: Mental walkthrough of yesterday's shoot-around
drills.description: Sit somewhere quiet. Close your eyes. Walk through every shot you took yesterday. Where were you? How did it feel?

drills.name: One-dribble pull-ups from the elbows
drills.description: One hard dribble, gather, pull up. Inside foot plants first. Right side first, then left.

drills.description: Hop into your shot off the catch. Both feet land together, square to the rim.

drills.name: Catch-and-shoot from 5 spots
drills.description: Spin pass to yourself. Catch in shot pocket, square hips and shoulders, shoot in rhythm. Spots: left corner, left wing, top, right wing, right corner.

drills.name: Step-back from the wing
drills.description: Drive baseline 2 steps, push off front foot, step back into shot pocket. Stay low through the move.

drills.name: 3-point catch-and-shoot from 5 spots
drills.description: Same 5 spots, behind the line. Spin pass, strong base, no fade.

drills.name: Side-step 3
drills.description: From the wing, one side-step dribble, square, shoot. Both feet behind the line.

drills.name: Late-clock decision drill
drills.description: Find clips with under :07 left on the shot clock. What do they go to? Note the patterns.

drills.name: Watch a possession and call it
drills.description: Watch one offensive possession from a recent NBA/college game. Pause before the play ends and call out what the offense is trying to do.

drills.name: Identify the pick-and-roll coverage
drills.description: Find a clip with a PnR. Pause as the screen is set. Identify: drop, ICE, switch, or hedge. Then watch how the play unfolds.

drills.name: Scout-yourself drill
drills.description: Write a one-paragraph scouting report on yourself. What would an opposing coach tell their team about you?

drills.name: Watch your role model
drills.description: Pick a player whose game you want to mirror. Watch 10 of their possessions. Take notes on their footwork and decision-making.

drills.name: Recognize defensive set
drills.description: Watch a half-court possession. Identify: man, 2-3 zone, 3-2 zone, switch, or junk. Bonus: what's the weak spot.

drills.name: Mental walkthrough of yesterday's shoot-around
drills.description: Sit somewhere quiet. Close your eyes. Walk through every shot you took yesterday. Where were you? How did it feel?

drills.name: Closeout recognition
drills.description: Find clips of contested 3s. Pause as the shooter catches. Predict: closeout type and best counter (shoot, rip, drive baseline).

drills.name: Spacing audit
drills.description: Watch your team's clips. Pause randomly. Are all 5 players in the right spots? What's missing?

drills.name: ATO study
drills.description: After-timeout sets. Find 3 examples from a college game. Why does it work? Who's the second cutter?

drills.name: Free throw mental rep
drills.description: Sit. Visualize the routine: 3 dribbles, breath, eyes up, shoot. 10 reps. No ball needed.

drills.name: Self-film review (any phone footage)
drills.description: Find one clip of yourself playing. Watch it 3 times. Different focus each watch: feet, hands, decision.

programs.summary: 3 days a week, 15 minutes a day. Center game iq + film program for high school players. Mix of foundation work and game-speed reps.

drills.name: Mental walkthrough of yesterday's shoot-around
drills.description: Sit somewhere quiet. Close your eyes. Walk through every shot you took yesterday. Where were you? How did it feel?

drills.name: Watch a possession and call it
drills.description: Watch one offensive possession from a recent NBA/college game. Pause before the play ends and call out what the offense is trying to do.

drills.name: Free throw mental rep
drills.description: Sit. Visualize the routine: 3 dribbles, breath, eyes up, shoot. 10 reps. No ball needed.

drills.name: Spacing audit
drills.description: Watch your team's clips. Pause randomly. Are all 5 players in the right spots? What's missing?

drills.name: ATO study
drills.description: After-timeout sets. Find 3 examples from a college game. Why does it work? Who's the second cutter?

drills.name: Recognize defensive set
drills.description: Watch a half-court possession. Identify: man, 2-3 zone, 3-2 zone, switch, or junk. Bonus: what's the weak spot.
